design_axis: APP VISUAL real secondary Production lifecycle-utilities route
bounded_question: Can five source-defined utility capacities be deliberately reached through the existing Settings route while retaining creative origin/focus, remaining secondary to Shaping and avoiding Product-dependent command authority?

close_reconciliation.effect: No contradiction at construction close; neither lane supplies Product utility-command semantics that supersede the accepted Design boundaries.

controlled_inputs: Light F2 / Dark D3 / MAT F1 / TYP F1 / STA F2 / FICON F1
accepted Production Lifecycle Utilities functional and Phase-3 evidence

local_result.summary: The existing Settings route now opens five descriptive utility capacities—Settings, Portable Production, Provider configuration, Diagnostics and Recovery utilities—while retaining The White Current/Scene 12 creative origin and exact focus return; no Product-effect command is introduced.

mechanical: seven-case origin + utility + return matrix PASS
visual: wide/narrow Settings utility Light/Dark pair with retained Production context
Settings capacity selected structurally while Portable Production carries independent focus
interaction: Settings route opens utilities while Shaping hides
five capacity rows update descriptive detail only
Back/Close restore original meaningful-element selection and creative focus

constrains: Future utility carriers preserve secondary Settings-route scope, navigation-versus-effect distinction, provider/Character separation, portability non-mutation, non-fictional diagnostics and exact creative return unless a named successor supersedes them.

explicit_non_authority: No final utility labels, menu placement, dialogs, commands or confirmation behavior.
No portable Production format, merge/overwrite/compatibility behavior or destinations.
No provider/model/cost policy, authentication, assignment, availability or Performer semantics.
No diagnostic, repair, fallback, recovery or destructive-action semantics.
No Production token freeze, infrastructure status colors, Stage successor, native implementation, shipping or Store authority.

director_review_surface.what_to_review: Settings-route hierarchy, five utility capacities, absence of effect commands, provider/portability/diagnostic boundaries and exact creative return
